'''A'Lerris Verata''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the Mining Chief Operator of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system's]] mining efforts during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was often seen patrolling the area around [[Nallera's Mining Field]] in her [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A'Lerris Verata appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
